Helping the Next Generation Push The Boundaries of Possibility
Join Our Team  

Co-ops

MKS offers seasonal co-ops that range from 3-8 month programs. We offer supplemental training and experience to students to advance their education and help you jumpstart an exciting career. Co-ops earn college credit while contribution to the long-term advancements of MKS’s initiatives and can be embedded in meaningful work. Applicants must be enrolled in an accredited undergraduate or graduate program and should consult with their institution to ensure eligibility for participation.

Internships

Internships at MKS are typically 10-12 weeks and a prime opportunity for students to accelerate their career by developing in-demand skills. Our interns are empowered to complete business critical work, and will have the opportunity to apply their studies to significant projects for the business while bringing their unique perspectives to the company.

Emerging Talent

At MKS, “Emerging Talent” refers to someone who has 0+ years of professional work experience. This includes internships, co-ops, and university students who will be graduating or who have recently graduated.

Employee Resource Groups

People do their best work when they feel a sense of belonging. At MKS, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, welcoming culture where everyone can thrive. Our Resource Groups (ERGs) are employee led communities that create opportunities for growth, help shape our culture, and strengthen engagement and impact.

veterans@mks

women@mks

Groups are open to all employees who wish to join.

Total Rewards & Benefits

At MKS, our commitment to your well-being is reflected in our comprehensive benefits package, encompassing medical coverage, paid time off, tuition and professional development assistance, and tools that enhance your health and well-being. We go beyond the traditional benefits package, promoting healthy behaviors and assisting you in making informed decisions. MKS values your unique talents and contributions. We recognize that employee satisfaction is essential to our success.

Join us in pushing the boundaries of possibility!

Hear From Our People

In 2001, I started as a production engineer working with laser systems. I then accepted responsibility for the site’s quality management. I now lead our growing cleanroom production team of 20 engineers and technicians, who are building our Explorer® Laser series. MKS has given me the opportunity and support to grow, and I now serve as a coach for our new production team. I'm able to lead with my personal value of respect for the individual and enjoy actively supporting the growth of those around me. I'm happy to be among peers who contribute their own perspectives and broaden my horizons.

I see MKS as a learning organization that welcomes every employee to shape MKS. As a global company, MKS accepts the mission of building cross functional, diverse, and multicultural teams that provide cutting edge technology for solving the world’s most challenging problems.

Oliver K.
Manager of Manufacturing &
Operations, Germany

I have witnessed the progress of MKS for 13 years. The cross-region communication enables me to develop multidimensional thought. MKS’ DE&I culture keeps me motivated, as they have enhanced my work-life balance and brought equal opportunities to female engineers.
Aimin S.
Manufacturing Engineering Manager,
China

I joined MKS as a Project Manager in the Laser R&D Product Development team (Spectra-Physics) and recently become an Engineering Manager within the Advanced Technology Development group. The opportunity to learn and grow my leadership skills, while staying true to my technical background is what initially drew me to MKS. My time here is a testimonial to those values and MKS's ability to uphold them. I take pride in being part of a company that prioritizes DEI initiatives and actively develops talent. MKS goes beyond mere statements and banners; it translates its vision into meaningful actions.
Shalaka D., PhD
Engineering Manager,
Lasers BU, United States

Recruiting Regulations

MKS has our own Talent Acquisition team which recruits on our behalf. If you are contacted by someone about a job at MKS, please verify the opportunity on our Careers Posting Site   before engaging with that contact. MKS does not ask for social security numbers or financial information. Please reach out to us if you have questions at: recruiting@mksinst.com.

MKS in India

In India, MKS has a strong team of 500 and are looking to grow our footprint. Learn more about MKS India career opportunities here.
